detail.longDescription:
On mobile devices only, after swiping the Owl Carousel with a finger, tapping a product or category link does not open it on the first tap. The link opens only after two consecutive taps or after waiting about 5 seconds. I want the link to open on the first tap. $(document).ready(function () { $(".owl-carousel").owlCarousel({ rtl: true, items: 2, margin: 10, loop: false, nav: true, dots: false, touchDrag: true, mouseDrag: true }); $(".owl-carousel").on("click", ".item a", function () { $("#result").text( "Click event detected: " + $(this).text() ); }); }); body { font-family: Arial, sans-serif; } #result { padding: 12px; margin: 12px 0; background: #f5f1eb; } .owl-carousel .item { padding: 10px; box-sizing: border-box; } .owl-carousel .item a { display: block; padding: 30px 10px; text-align: center; border: 1px solid #ccc; background: #f5f1eb; color: #222; text-decoration: none; border-radius: 8px; }
